section_summary.extract_value: This section describes measures used to assess media influences and positive body image: the Sociocultural Attitudes Towards Appearance Questionnaire-3 (SATAQ-3), a 30-item scale with four factors (Information, Pressure, Internalisation-General, Internalisation-Athlete) and reported Cronbach's alphas (Information .87; Pressure .83; Internalisation-General .91; Internalisation-Athlete .93), and the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item unidimensional measure of positive body image (Cronbach's alpha .90). The section does not identify any numbered studies (e.g., 'Study 1') nor provide sample characteristics, location, BMI assessment method, correlations between BAS and BMI, or sample size.
section_summary.evidence_source: Media influences were measured using the SATAQ-3, a 30-item scale measuring the multi-dimensional impact of sociocultural influences on body image.... In the present study, Cronbach's alpha coefficients were as follows: Information, .87; Pressure, .83; Internalisation-General, .91, and; Internalisation-Athlete, .93. Body Appreciation Scale (BAS; Avalos, Tylka, & Wood-Barcalow, 2005) The BAS, which measures aspects of positive body image, is a 13-item scale... Cronbach's alpha for this scale was .90.
